question: Ano ang mga kailangang i-upload at magkano ang bayad para sa online business locational clearance sa CPDO?
answer:
To apply for an online Business Locational Clearance (LC) through the City Planning and Development Office (CPDO), you need to upload the following documents:

1. The required documents enumerated in the checklist for the application form, as stated in [S1] Business Bureau CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf, printed page 105, chunk DEV120-BB-PDF0066-C002.

However, the specific documents required for the online Business LC application through CPDO can be found in the Citizen Charter for City Planning, specifically in [S2] City Planning CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-3.pdf, printed page 699, chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0070-C001.

As for the fees, the Mayor’s Permit Fee is based on the asset size and nature of business, and the service fee is PHP 50.00 for Amendment of Business Permit. (Please refer to [S3] Business Bureau CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf, printed page 80, chunk DEV120-BB-PDF0041-C001.)

ground_truth:
For online business locational clearance, the checklist lists: uploaded application form; Affidavit of Undertaking for neighbor consent with sketch map showing neighbor location (1 photocopy); Homeowners Association Certificate of No Objection; Certificate of Actual Land Occupancy for Migrant (based on RA8371); Locational Clearance for Building Permit, if applicable; PRC ID for licensed broker/License to Sell/Affidavit of Undertaking not to sell raw lots (PD957); Affidavit of Undertaking for Online Business/Booking Office/On-Job Site/On-Call/Private Garage; pictures showing working area including roads; and sketch map. Additional requirements may be required as the need arises.

The fee columns and TOTAL state None. The TOTAL is 1 Day and 50 Minutes. This includes denial-letter steps, with signature time dependent on administrator availability; it is not a guaranteed approval deadline. Approved/conditionally approved cases have their BPLS status updated and other offices then evaluate the application.
